Confluence 2: Rejection occurred precisely at the intersection of the Malaysian SNR resistance level (4411.11 - 4412.86) and the 4412.50 half-quarter level (Quarter Theory). This zone aligns with the descending bearish trendline on the H4 timeframe drawn from the 4443.20 swing high, further validated by the H4 EMA200 and Ichimoku cloud overhead resistance keeping the dominant HTF bearish trend intact.

Confluence 3: On the lower timeframes (M5), the price broke structure (BOS) by closing below the recent higher low of 4403.34. Confluence 4: The rally to 4416.18 represents a precise 0.707/0.786 Fibonacci retracement of the primary H4 bearish leg (4443.20 to 4341.97), terminating directly inside the H4 supply zone. On the M5 timeframe, this rejection has started forming a double top pattern, confirmed by volume indicators (OBV/CMF) showing distribution and declining buying volume on the retest of the highs.

Confluence 5: The H4 shooting star candle mitigated the unmitigated bearish order block from the 09-08 drop, while the lower timeframe (M5) displacement has left minor unmitigated gaps. The price spike to 4416.18 represents a +3 Standard Deviation move away from the H1 mean, which is highly unsustainable, and the subsequent bearish pin bar on the H1 timeframe confirms that the defensive staff zone is holding.
